text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! They can't keep up! No one can
catch up to
her!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса put up a brave fight
against
Сайленс Судзука, but she just
couldn't pull it off!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Pant, pant...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса runs with all her might.
However,
the Otherworldly
Front-Runner holds on to the
lead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: My arms... My legs... I can't breathe... Wheeze!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: This is... I...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Thunk!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: El? El!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Trainer! Call an ambulance!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Wee woo wee woo...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A complete examination reveals no
serious
injuries. Still...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer... No more...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I did my best... I used everything I had in
me to
beat Suzuka...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But even with all my strength and all the
effort I
put in training with you, it wasn't
good enough.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But now I'm... in pieces... A condor with
broken
wings.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If someone even stronger than Suzuka
shows up
at the Japan Cup, then...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders slump with
disappointment. It
seems like her
willpower has reached its limit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I... have to face the facts...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'm not... the world's strongest racer...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This race showed me that... I still have a
long way
ahead of me...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I can't do the Japan Cup... Not like this...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I just can't.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I concede to Эль Кондор Паса's
disappointment. It
looks like we're going
back to the drawing board
for this year's
plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her dream of taking on the Japan Cup in
her
classic year—once a lofty
ambition—has come
crashing down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
